supersedes: record_version 1 of this file, which carried PENDING_OWNER_COMPUTATION in place of the authoritative hash
status_semantics: No field named status. This record freezes the structural validity gate before it is used for population-level scientific classification.
position_in_chain: frozen OCR dec_extractor_v1 -> dec_validity_gate_v1 -> FK4(B1950) to FK5(J2000) -> D2 eligibility

why_a_separate_layer.trigger: The 84-page production pilot revealed SYNTACTICALLY_VALID_OCR_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_WITH_INVALID_COORDINATE_VALUE: 23 rows of 5610 transcribed, 0.41 percent, carried arcminute components of 60 or more.
why_a_separate_layer.why_the_extractor_was_not_changed: Editing the frozen extractor would have made its already-produced pilot outputs attributable to code that never ran, and would have moved the instrument while it was being used. The correction is therefore downstream and additive.
why_a_separate_layer.what_this_preserves: The raw extractor output survives unchanged in every record, so a later reviewer can see exactly what the OCR produced and exactly what the gate did with it.

the_binding_rule.statement: The gate may REJECT a value from scientific use. It may NEVER repair, infer, round, truncate or otherwise alter one.
the_binding_rule.worked_example: An arcminute component of 64 is not read as 04, 06 or 44. It is rejected, the original reading is preserved, and the row is sent to human review.
the_binding_rule.why: A repaired digit is indistinguishable from a correct one in the output. A rejected digit is visible. The whole point of the chain is that failures stay visible.

declared_parameters.ARCMIN_MAX_basis: DERIVATION. Sixty arcminutes make a degree, so a minute component of 60 or more cannot be a sexagesimal coordinate. This is not a judgement call.
declared_parameters.DEGREE_BAND_basis: CONTROLLER_CHOICE. No derivation fixes it. It is wide enough to contain every declination setting observed across the bracketed population with a large margin, and narrow enough to catch readings such as -76 or -97 that cannot belong to this material. Marked as a choice so it can never be read as derived.

what_STRUCTURALLY_ADMISSIBLE_does_not_me: It does not mean the value is the one printed on the page.
It does not mean the row is D2 eligible.
It does not remove the requirement for source-image verification of any record that is provisionally eligible, near a sealed B1 boundary, structurally invalid or OCR-conflicted.
It does not substitute for the sealed epoch transform.

known_limits.silent_errors_remain_possible: A misread that happens to be a possible coordinate passes the gate. For example a 6 read as 5 in the arcminute tens place yields a plausible value. The gate catches impossible values only, and cannot bound the rate of plausible-but-wrong ones.
known_limits.consequence: The population-level transcription audit and the source-image verification of boundary records are what address plausible-but-wrong values. The gate is a floor, not a guarantee.
known_limits.measured_effect_on_the_pilot: Applied to the pilot output the gate would move 23 rows from TRANSCRIBED to MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED on arcminute grounds, plus a small number of rows whose degree component lies outside the declared band.

hashes.computed_by: Owner, Get-FileHash on the project copy, 2026-08-18. PowerShell prints uppercase; the value is recorded here in lowercase and is the same digest.
hashes.committed_in: git commit e17c7d6, research: add frozen structural validity gate after pilot revealed invalid coordinate outputs
hashes.line_ending_caveat: The digest is of the bytes as they exist on the owner's disk. The repository carries .gitattributes disabling end-of-line conversion, so a clone reproduces the same bytes and therefore the same digest.

immutability_rule.statement: This gate version is never modified in place. Any change is a new version with its own freeze record, so that classifications remain attributable to the exact gate that produced them.
immutability_rule.scope_note: This freeze record itself was corrected once, from record_version 1 to 2, solely to insert the authoritative hash that could not be computed by the analyst. The gate code did not change.

commit_intent: research: record authoritative gate hash and enable the production integrity check
